# `document_citation_read_outcomes`

**Document citation read results**

Completed reads of specific document bodies. Zero findings means the body was read; a missing row means no recorded checkpoint.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Recorded attempts or producer outputs in the selected generation only; absent checkpoints and unobserved responses remain unknown. *(measured 2026-10-06)*

- **Parquet file:** `document_citation_read_outcomes.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `generation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Generation that converted the retained producer outputs. |
| `document_kind` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained source document kind. |
| `document_key` | `VARCHAR` | Exact native document key translated by the maintained source-kind rule. |
| `body_version_id` | `VARCHAR` | Exact text digest in the native body-version identity. |
| `text_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Retained text digest; this identifies text content, not original file bytes. |
| `rule_set_version` | `VARCHAR` | Citation rule set recorded by the completed read. |
| `read_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded time the citation read completed. |
| `citation_rows` | `BIGINT` | Recorded number of findings; zero is a completed zero-finding read. |
| `source_table` | `VARCHAR` | Selected main source table. |
| `input_family` | `VARCHAR` | Selected source publication family. |
| `input_generation` | `VARCHAR` | Exact source generation read by the checkpoint. |
| `input_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Retained selected input digest. |
